methods.label: Match variables and exponents
methods.explanation: Like terms must have the same variables, with matching exponents for each variable. The terms \(3ab\) and \(-ba\) have the same variables, all with exponent 1 (the order of the variables does not matter), so they are like terms; the other pairs have different variables or exponents.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 definition of like terms, exponent notation, and elementary commutativity of multiplication.
